messages.subject: Stockwise for Francis Ward
messages.body:
Hello,

Stockwise is an inventory and purchasing operations platform for inventory-based businesses.

I’m reaching out because Francis Ward appears to manage physical inventory, purchasing, or supplier operations.

Stockwise helps teams identify inventory exceptions, purchase-order priorities, and supplier follow-ups without relying on repeated manual spreadsheet checks.

Product information:
https://stockwise-homepage.vercel.app

NexOps. Inc
Stockwise: https://stockwise-homepage.vercel.app
NexOps. Inc LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/nexops2026/
nexops2026test@gmail.com

If you do not want to hear from me, reply “unsubscribe” and I will not contact you again.

publicCompanyEvidence.businessRelevance: Industrial containers and plastic products manufacturing.

publicLegalBasis.refusalCheckScope: No refusal observed on the reviewed official contact/about pages; recheck before send; no assertion about all site content.
